one_liner_zh: 輝瑞EPS低於預期9.48%，惟營收年增5.36%，非新冠藥品組合逐步回穩。
one_liner_en: Pfizer missed EPS by 9.48% but grew revenue 5.36%, with its non-COVID portfolio gradually stabilizing.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 0.47低於預期0.52（-9.48%），但營收年增5.36%。
ai_view_zh: 訊號好壞參半：營收年增5.36%顯示去新冠化後基期逐步回穩，但EPS不及預期9.48%反映成本、產品組合或研發費用壓力。短期股價可能因獲利缺口承壓，市場關注全年指引與成本撙節進度；19.94倍本益比已部分反映轉型不確定性。中期關鍵在腫瘤學整合與管線兌現。追蹤指標：非新冠營收成長、腫瘤事業表現、調整後營業利潤率與成本節省達成率、新藥審批與管線里程碑，以及股利覆蓋率。
ai_view_en: Signal is mixed: 5.36% revenue growth shows the base stabilizing after COVID normalization, but a 9.48% EPS miss reflects cost, mix, or R&D-expense pressure. Near-term the stock may face pressure from the earnings gap, with the market watching full-year guidance and cost-savings progress; a 19.94x P/E partly reflects transition uncertainty. Mid-term, oncology integration and pipeline delivery are key. Track: non-COVID revenue growth, oncology performance, adjusted operating margin and cost-savings attainment, drug approvals and pipeline milestones, and dividend coverage.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.47美元，低於預期0.52美元，負向驚喜9.48%
營收144.5億美元，年增5.36%顯示基期回穩
腫瘤學與核心藥品組合提供成長動能
成本撙節計畫持續推進以改善獲利結構
highlights_en: EPS of $0.47 missed the $0.52 estimate, a 9.48% negative surprise
Revenue of $14.45B grew 5.36%, indicating base stabilization
Oncology and core drug portfolio provide growth momentum
Cost-savings programs continue to improve the profit structure
risks_zh: 新冠相關產品需求大幅下滑後的基期與獲利壓力
重磅藥專利懸崖與研發管線兌現不確定性
EPS不及預期反映成本或產品組合壓力
risks_en: Base and profit pressure after the sharp decline in COVID-related demand
Patent cliffs for key drugs and pipeline-delivery uncertainty
The EPS miss reflects cost or product-mix pressure
